_meta.usage: Loaded at startup. Thresholds drive per-engine anomaly detection. fraud_risk_level: LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | CRITICAL

profiles.name: E-Commerce (General)
profiles.notes: High review fraud risk. Seasonal click spikes (BFCM) expected.

profiles.name: E-Commerce (Luxury Goods)
profiles.notes: High-value targets for fake review manipulation and brand impersonation.

profiles.name: E-Commerce (Dropshipping)
profiles.notes: Extremely high fake review prevalence. Low review counts are easily manipulated.

profiles.name: Cannabis (Licensed Retailer)
profiles.notes: Public signals ONLY. Cross-reference Health Canada license registry. Never access private accounts.

profiles.name: Cannabis (Suspected Unlicensed)
profiles.notes: PUBLIC signals ONLY. NEVER access private data. Always requires human review.

profiles.name: Advertising Agency
profiles.notes: IVT thresholds follow MRC standards. MFA domain detection applies.

profiles.name: Digital Marketing (SMB)
profiles.notes: SMBs often have lower traffic volumes, raising false positive risk. Adjust z-score windows.

profiles.name: Influencer Marketing
profiles.notes: Engagement rate anomaly is primary signal. Pod detection critical for mid-tier.

profiles.name: Programmatic Advertising
profiles.notes: Highest IVT exposure of any category. Domain spoofing and ad stacking are primary attack vectors.

profiles.name: Federal Government (Canada)
regulatory_bodies: Office of the Auditor General of Canada
profiles.notes: PSPC open data is primary source. Bid rotation CV < 0.2 among repeat winners is key signal.

profiles.name: Provincial Government
profiles.notes: Threshold amounts vary by province. Ontario: $100k MERX threshold.

profiles.name: Municipal Government
profiles.notes: Smaller procurement volumes require adjusted z-score windows (longer baseline).

profiles.name: Healthcare (Private Clinic)
profiles.notes: Misleading health claims are a regulatory violation beyond fraud. Flag for separate review.

profiles.name: Healthcare (Public / Hospital)
profiles.notes: PPE procurement is highest-risk category post-2020. Prioritize vendor concentration analysis.

profiles.name: Dental Practice
profiles.notes: Review fraud is primary concern. Competitors often use negative bombing tactics.

profiles.name: Financial Services (General)
profiles.notes: Financial advertising is highly regulated. False performance claims are primary concern.

profiles.name: Fintech / Online Lending
profiles.notes: APR disclosure fraud is regulatory-level. Coordinate with legal on flagged cases.

profiles.name: Cryptocurrency Exchange
profiles.notes: Pump-and-dump is coordinated with influencer fraud. Run both engines simultaneously.

profiles.name: Insurance
profiles.notes: Lead fraud (fake inquiries) is distinct from click fraud. Track conversion-to-quote ratio.

profiles.name: Real Estate (Residential)
profiles.notes: Phantom listings inflate agent metrics. Verify listing authenticity through public MLS.

profiles.name: Real Estate (Commercial)
profiles.notes: Commercial procurement often overlaps with gov fraud patterns. Run both engines.

profiles.name: Legal Services / Law Firm
profiles.notes: Testimonial claims are regulated by law society advertising rules.

profiles.name: Accounting / Tax Services
profiles.notes: Tax refund guarantee claims are specifically prohibited. Flag for separate analysis.

profiles.name: Consulting (Business / IT)
profiles.notes: Government IT consulting contracts are high-risk for sole-source abuse.

profiles.name: Recruitment / HR
profiles.notes: Ghost job postings waste applicant time — track apply-to-response rate anomalies.

profiles.name: Restaurant / Food Service
profiles.notes: Most review-intensive category. Competitive review bombing is extremely common.

profiles.name: Hotel / Hospitality
profiles.notes: Review platforms (TripAdvisor, Booking.com) have own fraud detection — supplement, not replace.

profiles.name: Food Delivery Platform
profiles.notes: Ghost kitchen review manipulation is a known fraud vector on Uber Eats / DoorDash.

profiles.name: Software / SaaS
profiles.notes: G2/Capterra/Trustpilot reviews are primary manipulation targets in SaaS.

profiles.name: Cybersecurity
profiles.notes: Efficacy claim fraud ('stops 100% of threats') is a primary competition concern.

profiles.name: AI / Machine Learning
profiles.notes: AI benchmark manipulation (cherry-picked tests) is not yet regulated but is a fraud signal.

profiles.name: Mobile App / App Store
profiles.notes: App install fraud often correlates with click fraud. Run both engines simultaneously.

profiles.name: Gaming / Online Games
profiles.notes: Gaming has the highest bot traffic ratio of any category. Adjust thresholds upward.

profiles.name: Telecommunications
profiles.notes: Coverage map misrepresentation is a known CRTC concern. Flag for separate analysis.

profiles.name: Private Education / Tutoring
profiles.notes: Employment outcome claims ('90% job placement') are a primary misleading advertising concern.

profiles.name: Online Education / EdTech
profiles.notes: Udemy/Coursera review manipulation is widespread. Accreditation fraud is separate concern.

profiles.name: Post-Secondary Institution
profiles.notes: Procurement fraud in capital projects and IT contracts is primary concern.

profiles.name: Construction
profiles.notes: Construction is the highest-risk sector for bid rigging cartels. Cover bidding is endemic.

profiles.name: Electrical Contractor
profiles.notes: License verification is critical — unlicensed contractor claims are a public safety issue.

profiles.name: Plumbing
profiles.notes: Emergency service fake reviews are a known tactic to exploit urgent consumer need.

profiles.name: HVAC
profiles.notes: Rebate and energy efficiency claim fraud is common in HVAC advertising.

profiles.name: Automotive Dealership
profiles.notes: All-in pricing regulations (Competition Act 2024 amendments) apply to advertised prices.

profiles.name: Automotive Repair
profiles.notes: Repair shop review manipulation often targets Google Maps specifically.

profiles.name: Energy / Utilities
profiles.notes: Energy contract door-to-door fraud is a known consumer protection issue in Ontario.

profiles.name: Mining & Natural Resources
profiles.notes: Junior mining company stock promotion fraud overlaps with influencer fraud patterns.

profiles.name: Pharmaceuticals (Controlled Substances)
profiles.notes: Online illegal pharmacy detection uses cannabis monitor patterns adapted for pharma context.

profiles.name: Pharmaceuticals (OTC / Supplements)
profiles.notes: Health claim fraud ('cures cancer') is a criminal offence in Canada. Always escalate to legal.

profiles.name: Beauty / Cosmetics
profiles.notes: Before/after photo manipulation is a key fraud signal alongside review fraud.

profiles.name: Fashion / Apparel
profiles.notes: Fast fashion dropship review fraud mirrors ecommerce_dropship patterns.

profiles.name: Fitness / Gym
profiles.notes: Gym contract cancellation fraud is a Consumer Protection Act concern alongside review fraud.

profiles.name: Weight Loss / Diet Products
profiles.notes: Highest misleading claim prevalence of any consumer product category. Always escalate.

profiles.name: Mental Health Services
profiles.notes: Unlicensed practice claims are a public safety issue beyond fraud. Always escalate.

profiles.name: Travel / Tourism
profiles.notes: Airline and hotel review fraud peaks during booking windows. Monitor seasonally.

profiles.name: Vacation Rental (Airbnb/VRBO)
profiles.notes: Phantom listing fraud is primary concern. Cross-check listing images for reuse across profiles.

profiles.name: Events & Entertainment
profiles.notes: Scalper bots inflate click traffic massively during sale windows. Temporal analysis critical.

profiles.name: Sports Betting / Online Gaming
profiles.notes: iGaming Ontario regulates all legal operators. Unlicensed operators are primary fraud target.

profiles.name: Non-Profit / Charity
profiles.notes: Fake charity solicitations spike after natural disasters. Seasonal monitoring recommended.

profiles.name: Political Organization
profiles.notes: Political astroturfing is regulated under the Canada Elections Act. Always legal referral.

profiles.name: Media / Publishing
profiles.notes: News site ad fraud (MFA patterns) is primary concern for publishers monetizing via programmatic.

profiles.name: Social Media Platform
profiles.notes: Platform-level fraud detection is out of scope for VIGILAX. Focus on entities using platforms.

profiles.name: Streaming Service
profiles.notes: Content rating manipulation (IMDB/RT scores) is a known fraud vector alongside ad fraud.

profiles.name: Agriculture
profiles.notes: Organic certification fraud and agri-food subsidy fraud are primary concerns.

profiles.name: Food Manufacturing
profiles.notes: Allergen and nutrition label fraud is a public health concern beyond competition law.

profiles.name: Logistics / Shipping
profiles.notes: Government logistics contracts are high-risk for single-vendor concentration.

profiles.name: Supply Chain / Procurement
profiles.notes: Phantom invoice detection requires cross-referencing vendor lists against delivery records.

profiles.name: Aerospace & Defense (Government)
profiles.notes: Defense procurement is highest-value per-contract. Single-vendor flags are critical.

profiles.name: Infrastructure (Roads, Bridges, Transit)
profiles.notes: Bid rotation cartels are well-documented in Canadian road construction. CV < 0.2 is key.

profiles.name: Staffing / Temp Agency
profiles.notes: Government staffing contracts are high-risk for vendor concentration and ghost employees.

profiles.name: Printing / Publishing
profiles.notes: Government printing contracts can exhibit bid rigging. Low overall risk.

profiles.name: Cleaning Services
profiles.notes: Government facility cleaning contracts are common bid-rigging targets.

profiles.name: Security Guarding
profiles.notes: Security license fraud creates public safety risk. Always cross-reference provincial license registry.

profiles.name: Insurance Brokerage
profiles.notes: Misleading premium quotes in digital ads are a primary FSRA concern.

profiles.name: Mortgage Broker
profiles.notes: Rate guarantee claims are regulated. Income inflation in applications is out of VIGILAX scope.

profiles.name: Investment Advisor
profiles.notes: Return guarantee claims are securities fraud. Always legal referral when flagged.

profiles.name: Payday Lending
profiles.notes: 2396% APR cap under Ontario Payday Loans Act. Any implied exception is a criminal matter.

profiles.name: MLM / Network Marketing
profiles.notes: Pyramid scheme detection is Competition Act criminal. Income claims without disclosure are prohibited.

profiles.name: Franchise
profiles.notes: Franchise disclosure document fraud is distinct from review fraud. Flag for legal review.

profiles.name: Home Improvement
regulatory_bodies: Consumer Protection Ontario (Ontario New Home Warranties Plan Act)
profiles.notes: Deposit fraud (paid, no work done) is a consumer protection crime under CPA 2002.

profiles.name: Moving & Storage
profiles.notes: Hostage cargo fraud (holding goods for inflated payment) is criminal. Always legal referral.

profiles.name: Wedding / Event Planning
profiles.notes: Vendor ghost accounts (venue, photographer, caterer) use cross-referencing review tactics.

profiles.name: Pet Services
profiles.notes: Puppy mill fraud listing detection uses review and photo duplication signals.

profiles.name: Veterinary Services
profiles.notes: Low risk. Review fraud is the primary concern.

profiles.name: Childcare / Daycare
regulatory_bodies: Child Care and Early Years Act
profiles.notes: License and ratio misrepresentation is a public safety matter. Cross-reference provincial registry.

profiles.name: Elder Care / Long-Term Care
profiles.notes: Elder care procurement fraud is high-priority post-COVID. Billing fraud requires MOHLTC referral.

profiles.name: PR / Communications
profiles.notes: Sock puppet and astroturfing campaigns are difficult to distinguish from organic. Human review required.

profiles.name: SEO Agency
profiles.notes: Click fraud to artificially improve CTR metrics for clients is a documented SEO fraud tactic.

profiles.name: Affiliate Marketing
profiles.notes: Cookie stuffing and forced click injection are primary attack vectors in affiliate networks.

profiles.name: CBD / Hemp Products
profiles.notes: CBD health claims are regulated — therapeutic claims require DIN. Public signals only.

profiles.name: Psychedelics (Clinical / Research)
profiles.notes: Psilocybin and MDMA therapy requires Section 56 exemption or SAP. Public signals only.

profiles.name: Tobacco / Vaping
profiles.notes: Youth targeting in vape advertising is a federal offence. Influencer fraud engine applies.

profiles.name: Firearms / Weapons (Licensed)
profiles.notes: Public signals only. ANY unlicensed sale signal requires immediate RCMP referral.

profiles.name: Waste Management / Municipal Services
profiles.notes: Waste hauling is a documented bid-rigging sector in Canada. Cover bidding is endemic.

profiles.name: IT Services / Managed Services
profiles.notes: Government IT managed services contracts are highest-risk for sole-source abuse in tech sector.

profiles.name: Cloud Services
profiles.notes: SLA uptime misrepresentation is primary concern in cloud services advertising.

profiles.name: Taxi / Rideshare
profiles.notes: Driver review manipulation is common on both Uber and Lyft platforms.

profiles.name: Trucking / Freight
profiles.notes: Load fraud (phantom shipments on broker platforms) is out of scope but flagging is appropriate.

profiles.name: Aviation
profiles.notes: Aviation procurement is safety-critical. Always legal referral on findings.

profiles.name: Photography / Creative Services
profiles.notes: Low risk. Review fraud and fake portfolio images are primary signals.

profiles.name: Design Agency
profiles.notes: Design award fraud (fake Awwwards/Behance) can inflate agency credibility artificially.

profiles.name: Esports / Competitive Gaming
profiles.notes: Match fixing detection is out of scope but viewership inflation is within ad fraud engine.

profiles.name: NFT / Web3
profiles.notes: Rug pull signals include sudden liquidity removal and coordinated social pump. Human review critical.

profiles.name: Charitable Foundation
profiles.notes: Charity misrepresentation (using 100% of donations for admin) is a CRA criminal referral.

profiles.name: Immigration Consulting
regulatory_bodies: CICC (College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants)
profiles.notes: Ghost consultant fraud and guarantee claims are criminal under IRPA. Always legal referral.

profiles.name: Courier / Last-Mile Delivery
profiles.notes: Phishing using fake delivery notifications is out of scope but related.

profiles.name: Solar Energy
profiles.notes: Solar savings guarantee claims and government rebate fraud are primary concerns.

profiles.name: Water Treatment / Municipal Infrastructure
profiles.notes: Water infrastructure procurement fraud is public safety critical. Always escalate.

profiles.name: General / Unknown Industry
profiles.notes: Default profile used when industry cannot be determined. Apply conservative thresholds.
